fields.imageBrief: Windows desktop browser window showing a plain institutional web portal with a left navigation list and a table of rows with colored status badges, one green and three amber, no readable text

instructorNote: This is a clue inject. The clock board was never linked to the award term, so row 3 still shows 7 days, but the Iowa Corn Growers Board term requires notice within 72 hours, which makes Friday 16 Oct 2026 09:02 the real deadline. Check that the RC fixes the board, writes down that the stricter term governs, and names who sends the notice, how and when. The IO should confirm that rule. Also look for someone to point out that the NIH row depends on the IBC chair's classification and could get shorter, with the clock still running from discovery at 09:02.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: A monitor photographed at an angle, slight moiré and reflections. A desktop computer monitor photographed at a slight angle on a cluttered biosafety office desk, showing a plain institutional web portal in a browser window: a pale grey left navigation column, a white main panel with a simple table of four horizontal rows, one row marked by a small green status badge and three rows by amber badges, all lines of type too small and soft to read from this distance. Beside the keyboard sit a ceramic coffee mug, a printed binder and a lab coat draped over the chair back. Cool overcast mid-morning daylight from a window mixes with the screen glow, shallow depth of field, focus on the amber badges, quiet and tense.
